title: Variety
description: A variety of universal algebras as data: a signature (a finite list of operation symbols with arities) and a set of equations defining the variety. The category Var's objects each conform to this shape; individual algebras (objects of a given variety) conform to that variety's own schema (e.g., bilattice.schema.json).

signature.description: The variety's signature: each entry names an operation symbol and its arity.

equations.description: The variety's defining equations as pairs of terms over the signature. Term-encoding is implementation-defined and out of JSON Schema's reach; the consuming verifier checks term well-formedness and equational closure.
